title: App connects with a limited account
steps: config/database.js opens a pool with the .env settings; try a DROP TABLE as the app
sql: SELECT CURRENT_USER(); SHOW GRANTS; DROP TABLE lpa_stock_ledger
expected: Connected as lpa_app with SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE only; DROP refused
actual: lpa_app@localhost on lpa_ecomms (10.11.14-MariaDB-0ubuntu0.24.04.1); grants: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE; DROP -> ER_TABLEACCESS_DENIED_ERROR

title: Database password is not in the code or in Git
expected: .env ignored; no password in the code; example file has a placeholder only
actual: .env in .gitignore = true; git: .env not checked (no git here); password in config = false; example placeholder = true

title: Read: the Stock page shows the rows in lpa_stock
steps: Open Stock; compare with a SELECT
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lpa_stock WHERE lpa_stock_status <> 'x'
expected: Same number of items; item detail shows the price and on-hand from the table
actual: table 8 rows, page 8 cards; LPA-001 $89.00 / 12 on hand shown = true

title: Create: Add stock item inserts a row
expected: Redirect to the new item; the row is in lpa_stock
actual: 302 -> /products/LPA-020; row = Laptop Stand LS-3, $45, 9, status a

title: Update: Edit item changes the row
expected: Row has the new price and quantity

title: Delete: item is soft-deleted
expected: Row kept with status x (history keeps working); item no longer listed

title: Validation stops bad data before it reaches the table
steps: Save items with a 260-character name, price -5, Stock ID "LPA 0;1", price 1,000,000
expected: All refused (400) with a message; no rows added
actual: 400/400/400/400; messages: true, true, true, true; rows 9 -> 9

title: SQL injection attempts do nothing
steps: Search stock for ' OR '1'='1; search sales for x'; DROP TABLE lpa_invoices; --; log in as palvim' --
sql: All values sent as ? parameters (prepared statements)
actual: stock results 0; sales results 0; tables 6; login -> /login?error=2&u=palvim'%20--

title: Transaction: a failed invoice saves nothing
steps: New invoice: webcam x2 (in stock) + dock x999 (only 4)
sql: START TRANSACTION ... SELECT ... FOR UPDATE ... ROLLBACK
expected: Refused (400); webcam stock, invoices and ledger unchanged
actual: 400 "Only 4 of USB-C Docking Station DS-11 on hand (asked for 999)."; webcam 20 -> 20; invoices 6 -> 6; ledger 4 -> 4

title: Two sales at once cannot oversell
steps: Send two invoices at the same moment, each for all 4 docks
sql: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE locks the stock row until COMMIT
expected: Exactly one is saved; the other is refused; stock ends at 0 (never negative)

title: Foreign keys protect the history
steps: Change the Stock ID of LPA-001 (on invoices); insert an invoice for client CL-999 (does not exist)
actual: rename -> 409 "used on invoices..."; LPA-001 kept = true; bad invoice -> ER_NO_REFERENCED_ROW_2

title: Checkout writes invoice, items, stock and ledger
steps: Customer adds numpad x2, checks out with PayPal
sql: INSERT lpa_invoices + lpa_invoice_items; UPDATE lpa_stock; INSERT lpa_stock_ledger (one transaction)
expected: Invoice for CL-006 $68.00 PayPal, 1 line, stock 15 -> 13, ledger by aturner
actual: INV-1008: CL-006 $68.00 PayPal; lines 1; ledger aturner 15 -> 13

title: Data is still there after the app restarts
steps: Start a NEW app process; open the order made in DB-12 and the deleted item
sql: SELECT on start-up of a new process
expected: Order found with the same amount; deleted item still deleted

title: Clear message when the database is not available
steps: Start the app with a wrong DB password, then try to log in
expected: Start-up warning in the console; user sees 503 "database is not available"; no technical details
actual: console warning = true; status 503; message = true; leaks = false

title: Database exported to db/export.sql
expected: 6 tables with their data; hashes only, no plain passwords
actual: 6 tables; 6 INSERT blocks; 11.7 KB; plain password = false
